decisions.rationale: "Wilms' tumour" is a disease name used as a modifier of the noun "gene" in the gene name "Wilms' tumour gene" (WT1). It is not a standalone disease mention, so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: 3. Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: "Denys-Drash syndrome" names one specific, well-defined disease with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease. Its full name is kept as the minimum necessary span.

decisions.rationale: "renal failure" is an umbrella term covering several distinct forms (e.g., acute and chronic renal failure), so it is treated as a family of diseases and annotated as a Disease Class.

decisions.rationale: "intersex disorders" refers to a group of multiple specific disorders of sex development rather than a single disease, so it is a Disease Class.
